method: Read-only Python source and actual local UE5.8 C++ API inspection; Python AST parse only. No Unreal calls, imports, saves or source edits by reviewer.
conclusion: No blocking missing UE API found for the planned saved idle-editor import and fresh-process persistence validation. Both previously reported guard weaknesses are now closed by root and independently source-rechecked. Actual import/runtime success remains unmeasured.

verified_against_local_primary_cpp.check: ImportNormals, MikkTSpace and weighted-normal option are reflected
verified_against_local_primary_cpp.result: Normal import/generation enums and the three editable UPROPERTY settings exist. Explicit settings avoid the constructor's ComputeNormals/weighted-normal defaults.

verified_against_local_primary_cpp.check: Normal import settings drive the actual skeletal build
verified_against_local_primary_cpp.result: Authored normals are retained when present; ImportNormals recomputes tangents, MikkTSpace is selected, and weighted-normal setting is transferred. If FBX contains no normals, engine recomputes them despite the option; the readback is configuration evidence rather than a measured tangent-basis comparison.

verified_against_local_primary_cpp.check: Saved mesh import data is reflected
verified_against_local_primary_cpp.result: AssetImportData is an instanced editor UPROPERTY; get_editor_property is appropriate for readback. Plain C++ accessor presence is not used as proof of a Python UFUNCTION.

verified_against_local_primary_cpp.check: PBR compression and sampler pairs match
verified_against_local_primary_cpp.result: Non-virtual TC_Normalmap uses Normal, TC_Masks uses Masks, and sRGB default color uses Color. Normal/Masks require sRGB disabled. The reviewed four-channel parent uses these pairs.
Getter reads the actual texture parameter. Setter leaves bResult false even after setting/updating the override; the script correctly checks the getter instead of relying on the setter bool.

verified_against_local_primary_cpp.check: LOD count can be queried during PIE
verified_against_local_primary_cpp.result: GetLODCount only checks null and returns GetLODNum, so the PIE count check is valid. RegenerateLOD/GetNumVerts/GetNumSections reject PIE and are confined to idle-editor validation/import.

implementation_review.owned_scope: Exactly 24 intended dependencies under RefinedV2: mesh/skeleton/Idle, one new parent, four MICs, 16 textures. Partial or changed-provenance scopes abort before guide replacement.
implementation_review.save_order: Textures, parent, MICs, skeleton, animation and mesh are explicitly persisted before the existing guide appearance update. Existing dialogue, supplies, data references and transforms are compared against the recorded baseline.
implementation_review.fresh_process: Fresh script loads StartHub and calls main(validate_only=True). This branch loads/checks assets and writes evidence JSON; it performs no explicit asset import, setting, LOD regeneration or asset save. NullRHI is correctly described as persistence verification only.
implementation_review.pie_hook_reload: Reloading ValidateTutorialNPC before capturing original_prepare/original_dialogue clears completed prior v1 monkey-patched functions and resets report state. Reload must occur while no validator callback is active.

findings.issue: Substring FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS also accepts FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS_AND_TANGENTS, so the current normal mode readback is not strict.
findings.recommended_root_fix: Compare the reflected enum value directly with unreal.FBXNormalImportMethod.FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS, and compare the generation enum directly with MIKK_T_SPACE. Keep string conversion for reporting only.

findings.issue: Reloading the module while an earlier validator is active resets its globals before main's duplicate guard. A previously registered callback still uses that same module globals dictionary.
findings.recommended_root_fix: Before importlib.reload, refuse an unfinished unreal._rogue10m_tutorial_npc_validator or existing PIE. Do not unregister or take over another active run automatically.
findings.precondition: Root's planned invocation is an idle editor after the prior validator completed.
